question.prompt: Two sides of a right triangle have lengths 3 and 4. Find all possible values of the square of the length of the third side. Give your answers in ascending order, separated by commas.

solutions.explanation: If 4 is the hypotenuse, the square of the third side is \(16-9=7\). If 3 and 4 are both legs, the square of the third side (the hypotenuse) is \(9+16=25\).
solutions.title: Consider the possible hypotenuse
